scope: MCHOSE V3 native keyboard assignments and corresponding UI
scenarios: All 96 rendered main-key choices submit correct plain-key payloads
Generic chord and modifier-only assignments use their distinct proved native types
All 15 nonzero generic modifier masks pass native stateful apply/readback
Malformed sizes, masks, reserved usages and modifier-as-main inputs reject before SET or backup
Successful SET acknowledgement without matching readback returns failure without resending
Other buttons, unknown raw actions, three board states and the other mouse remain unchanged
Actual UI requests deserialize to production Action and execute production framing/apply/readback
Eight macro modifier usages remain distinct and balanced
F13..F24 remain outside the proved picker rather than being silently mapped
limits: These are simulated native protocol and built-UI tests, not firmware or physical playback certification
General chord modifiers deliberately follow the OEM four generic bits; macro usages do not prove eight-bit chord masks
Macro raw-byte preservation and opaque-field editing are separate pending work; see mchose-v3-macro-official-facts.json
Historical physical model word4026 and current official catalog4033 differ; no new model PID was enabled
Installed application, GitHub release and updater feed remain at the previously published version
